thread:
jordan: FYI we got a billing exception from Marketplace for SI-Partner. Their nightly batch replayed with overlapping windows and produced negative deltas in the ledger.

lydia: negative deltas? that's bad. do we have the raw batch manifest or sample?

si-partner: sending excerpt from the partner manifest (sanitized): ```text
manifest_id: mf-2026-03-22
batches: [
  {seq_no: 42, start: 2026-03-22T00:00:00Z, end: 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z, checksum: abc123},
  {seq_no: 43, start: 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z, end: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z, checksum: def456}  <-- overlap
]
```

pranav: looks like they replayed a partial hour (00:30-01:00) as a separate batch with seq_no higher than the original hour. our ingestion applies batches idempotently by (partner_id, seq_no) only, so overlapping intervals are being added on top of prior hourly totals.

jordan: ahhh so not dedupe per-window, dedupe per-seq. we need either interval canonicalization or a watermark + apply-once semantics.

eng-bot: created ticket PARTNER-3499: "SI-Partner overlapping-batch negative-delta remediation" assigned to lydia. https://redwood.internal/partners/3499

lydia: proposed mitigation: 1) reject batches whose start/end intersect already-committed windows unless they declare "patch=true"; 2) require manifest checksums match stored manifest; 3) if patch=true, accept but mark ledger as 'patch' and run correction flow that computes diff vs previous committed interval before writing credits.

pranav: for immediate stopgap, we can run a correction query that finds hours where sum(units) < 0 and auto-reconcile by computing the expected net from last-good-manifest. SQL prototype: ```sql
WITH per_hour AS (
  SELECT partner_id, date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hr, sum(units) AS total
  FROM partner_batch_events
  WHERE batch_manifest = 'mf-2026-03-22' OR batch_manifest IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY partner_id, hr
)
SELECT * FROM per_hour WHERE total < 0;
```
then backfill delta rows with type='correction' and note original_seq_nos.

marketplace: remind that corrections must be visible to customers and reconciled in billing run so they don't see sudden refunds as 'mysterious credits'. include reason code.

si-partner: our ops will stop replays until we align on manifest semantics. we'll also add an explicit "window_scope" field to batches (hourly|partial|patch) and start monotonically increasing seq_no per manifest.

jordan: long-term change: change dedupe key from (partner_id, seq_no) to (partner_id, interval_hash) where interval_hash = sha256(start_iso + end_iso + checksum). that prevents double-apply for overlapping content. fallback: require partners to always submit canonical hourly aggregates unless they use patch flag.

lydia: also add an ingestion-time invariant: if batch overlaps a previously ingested window and batch.seq_no > committed_seq_no AND not patch, reject with 409 and include guidance. we'll add acceptance tests to integration/partners/si-partner/overlap.spec.ts.

pranav: dev estimate: stopgap detection + correction script ~6h, API rejection + tests ~1.5d. I'll pair with infra for manifest storage.

eng-bot: posted ops alert to #incidents: "Partner batch overlap caused ledger negative deltas. PARTNER-3499"

marketplace: comms ask: please prepare a short customer note explaining the correction window and that any credits will appear in next invoice as line-item "metering correction". avoid specifying partner names.

jordan: lydia will handle partner contract change to require either canonical hourly files or patch semantics for partial intervals. also update partner onboarding checklist to validate seq_no monotonicity.

si-partner: we'll push a hotfix to our uploader tonight to stop sending partial overlapping batches; ETA 03/23 02:00Z. we'll also provide a signed manifest for replayed days.

lydia: follow-ups: 1) run correction job once partner confirms stop, 2) update ingestion docs with overlap policy, 3) confirm monitoring alert for negative-hour totals. i'll own monitoring.

jordan: thanks all. meeting at 11 to triage if anything else emerges. :thumbsup:
